title: Countertop Soap Dispenser 5-Ounce Solid Brass Waverly Place Collection | Satin Nickel | Allied Brass
short_title: Countertop Soap Dispenser 5-Ounce | Allied Brass, Satin Nickel
description:
Upgrade your bathroom counter with a space-saving soap dispenser featuring a generous 5 ounce bottle and solid brass construction in Satin Nickel, which offers a warm, brushed finish that hides water spots and fingerprints, perfect for high-use bathrooms. Designed for soap, lotion, or hand sanitizer, it adds coordinated style to vanities and sink areas in the Waverly Place collection.

Highlights:
- Satin Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Crafted from solid brass for enduring everyday use
- Traditional design with classic elements for versatile bath accessories
-  to coordinate with transitional bathroom hardware

- Collection: Waverly Place
- Mounting type: Countertop
